title.zh: 将第190号法案——《菲律宾群岛民事诉讼与特别程序法典》的生效日期由1901年9月1日延展至1901年10月1日的法案
title.en: AN ACT EXTENDING THE TIME ON WHICH ACT NUMBERED ONE HUNDRED AN NINETY, PROVIDING A CODE OF PROCEDURE IN CIVIL ACTIONS AND SPECIAL PROCEEDINGS IN THE PHILIPPINE ISLANDS, SHALL TAKE EFFECT, FROM THE FIRST DAY OF SEPTEMBER, TO THE FIRST DAY OF OCTOBER, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND ONE.
title.orig: AN ACT EXTENDING THE TIME ON WHICH ACT NUMBERED ONE HUNDRED AN NINETY, PROVIDING A CODE OF PROCEDURE IN CIVIL ACTIONS AND SPECIAL PROCEEDINGS IN THE PHILIPPINE ISLANDS, SHALL TAKE EFFECT, FROM THE FIRST DAY OF SEPTEMBER, TO THE FIRST DAY OF OCTOBER, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND ONE.
title.vi: Đạo luật gia hạn thời điểm có hiệu lực của Đạo luật số 190, quy định Bộ Quy tắc Thủ tục trong Các Vụ Kiện Dân sự và Các Thủ tục Đặc biệt tại Quần đảo Philippines, từ ngày 1 tháng Chín đến ngày 1 tháng Mười năm 1901
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติขยายระยะเวลาที่พระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่190 ซึ่งกำหนดประมวลวิธีพิจารณาคดีแพ่งและวิธีพิจารณาคดีพิเศษในหมู่เกาะฟิลิปปินส์ มีผลบังคับใช้ จากวันที่1เดือนกันยายน ถึงวันที่1เดือนตุลาคม พ.ศ.2444
title.id: Undang-Undang Memperpanjang Waktu Berlakunya Undang-Undang Nomor 190 yang Menetapkan Kode Prosedur dalam Gugatan Perdata dan Prosedur Khusus di Kepulauan Filipina dari 1 September hingga 1 Oktober 1901
title.ms: Akta Memperpanjang Tarikh Berkuat Kuasa Akta Nombor 190 yang Menetapkan Kod Prosedur dalam Tindakan Sivil dan Prosiding Khas di Kepulauan Filipina daripada 1 September hingga 1 Oktober 1901

source.name: The LawPhil Project — Arellano Law Foundation

text.en:
The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, August 31, 1901.
